name: trains_a
prompt:
Two images are attached. The first is a layout: 12 rail vehicle outlines seen from above, packed in 5 rows on a flat magenta background. Every outline is the vehicle's true length and width on one shared scale, so they are long thin strips, and every vehicle lies along its row from left to right, its front at its outline's thick right edge. The second image shows finished road vehicles from the same game, in the art style to match. Copy its style only, not its vehicles or colours.

Make one image with exactly the same layout as the first image: the same 12 outlines in the same places at the same sizes. Inside each outline, draw the rail vehicle described for that cell below, as a top-down sprite for a 2D city game.

An earlier attempt drew every vehicle about 12% wider than its outline, its side walls showing below the roof, and its buffers and a tank's ladder standing past the outline's ends. Not this time: the roof alone fills each outline exactly, edge to edge, no side wall at all; the buffers are short stubs inside the outline's ends; nothing reaches past any outline.

Shape comes first:
- Fill each outline: same length, same width, horizontal. Never make a vehicle shorter, longer or fatter than its outline.
- Draw nothing outside the outlines: no track, rails, sleepers or ballast, no couplings between cells.
- Each vehicle is mirror-symmetric about its long centre line.
- Inside a vehicle there is no magenta at all.

Rules for every vehicle:
- Look straight down (orthographic). Only the roof and what stands on it shows: no side walls, no windows along the sides, no wheels, no bogies, no perspective, no tilt, no ground, no shadow.
- Style: match the style image. Chunky pixel art with crisp hard-edged pixels and no blur. A dark near-black outline about 2 pixels thick. Flat colour with one highlight and one shadow tone. Soft light from the top-left. A locomotive's cab windscreen is dark slate blue with one pale glint, seen as a strip at each end.
- Couplers or buffers show as short stubs at both ends, inside the outline.
- No text, logos, numbers, people or watermark anywhere.
- Outside the vehicles, keep the background flat pure magenta #FF00FF. No grid lines or frames.
